title: Mutable Git source references can reach Framework provisioning consumption
summary: Framework provisioning now binds CRS consumption to the centrally approved literal HTTPS origin and reviewed lower-case 40-character commit. Mutable caller selectors cannot select CRS content, and fetch, resolution, and checkout identities are verified before consumption.
summary_de: Die Framework-Provisionierung bindet die CRS-Consumption nun an den zentral freigegebenen literalen HTTPS-Origin und den geprüften kleingeschriebenen 40-Zeichen-Commit. Mutable Aufruferselektoren können keine CRS-Inhalte auswählen, und Fetch-, Auflösungs- und Checkout-Identitäten werden vor der Consumption verifiziert.
observed_behavior: Before remediation, CRS_GIT_REF=main could reach a Git source-ref selector. The current master tree rejects divergent CRS_REPO_URL and CRS_GIT_REF values before Git; a fresh repository fetches only the approved full commit and verifies FETCH_HEAD, resolved object, and final HEAD.
observed_behavior_de: Vor der Remediation konnte CRS_GIT_REF=main einen Git-Quellref-Selektor erreichen. Der aktuelle Master-Tree lehnt abweichende CRS_REPO_URL- und CRS_GIT_REF-Werte vor Git ab; ein frisches Repository fetcht nur den freigegebenen Vollcommit und verifiziert FETCH_HEAD, aufgelöstes Objekt und finales HEAD.
expected_behavior: CRS provisioning may consume only the centrally approved literal HTTPS origin and lower-case 40-character immutable commit. The release label is metadata, never a Git content selector. Existing source paths, origin mismatch, identity mismatch, and .gitmodules declarations fail closed.
expected_behavior_de: Die CRS-Provisionierung darf nur den zentral freigegebenen literalen HTTPS-Origin und kleingeschriebenen 40-Zeichen-unveränderlichen Commit konsumieren. Das Release-Label ist Metadatum und niemals Git-Inhaltsselektor. Bestehende Quellpfade, Origin-Mismatch, Identitäts-Mismatch und .gitmodules-Deklarationen schlagen sicher fehl.
impact: The verified boundary prevents caller-controlled selectors, mutable tags or branches, and ref-namespace spellings from selecting the CRS source tree consumed by Framework provisioning and rule preparation.
impact_de: Die verifizierte Grenze verhindert, dass aufruferkontrollierte Selektoren, mutable Tags oder Branches und Ref-Namespace-Schreibweisen den von Framework-Provisionierung und Regelvorbereitung konsumierten CRS-Quellbaum auswählen.

The exact Framework PR #26 head was 465766c01e2bb0a9a003cfcefa8afca5fceeafe0 and the resulting current Framework master is 36cac3029c735dddf9f717b3ce077b9285567a6a.

root_cause: The CRS provisioning path accepted the mutable CRS_GIT_REF release tag as a Git source selector and detached FETCH_HEAD without binding consumption to a reviewed immutable commit identity.
root_cause_de: Der CRS-Provisioning-Pfad akzeptierte das mutable CRS_GIT_REF-Release-Tag als Git-Quellselektor und checkte FETCH_HEAD aus, ohne die Consumption an eine überprüfte unveränderliche Commit-Identität zu binden.
proposed_remediation: Implemented central approved origin, release metadata, and full-commit constants; pre-Git divergent-selector rejection; full-commit validation; isolated Git invocation; fresh-source-only creation; literal-commit fetch; FETCH_HEAD/resolved-object/HEAD equality checks; and fail-closed .gitmodules handling.
proposed_remediation_de: Implementiert wurden zentrale Konstanten für freigegebenen Origin, Release-Metadaten und Vollcommit, die Ablehnung abweichender Selektoren vor Git, Vollcommit-Validierung, isolierter Git-Aufruf, Erstellung nur frischer Quellen, Fetch des literalen Commits, Gleichheitsprüfungen von FETCH_HEAD/aufgelöstem Objekt/HEAD und sicher fehlschlagende .gitmodules-Behandlung.
acceptance_criteria: Provisioning uses only the literal approved HTTPS origin and lower-case 40-character full commit.

Tags, branches, ref namespaces, abbreviated hashes, divergent environment selectors, inherited Git controls, existing source paths, and .gitmodules declarations fail closed before CRS content is consumed.
A fresh approved-origin control verifies FETCH_HEAD, resolved-object, detached checkout, and final HEAD equality without invoking a submodule command.
The exact final PR #26 head passes all required fresh-head checks and the resulting Framework master reruns the original negative reproduction and legitimate control successfully.
validation_plan: Run mocked negative and legitimate-control Git/provenance fixtures.
Run focused Framework CRS provenance regression, documentation checks, and Framework lint with a task-owned external bytecode cache when the retained worktree is read-only.
Verify exact-head PR #26 CI, SonarCloud Code Analysis, reviews, and review threads without waiving fresh PR-head checks.
Verify the merge receipt and current master SHA, tree equality, diff cleanliness, unchanged MRTS, and resulting-master checks.
regression_tests: tests/security_regression/test_crs_git_ref_provenance.py: ten focused mocked Git/provenance tests passed on the current master tree, including the original main-selector rejection.
legitimate_control_tests: The process-boundary fake-Git fixture accepts only the approved literal origin and 55b09f5acfd16413e7b31041100711ceb7adc89c commit, then observes exact fetch, resolution, detached checkout, and final-HEAD verification on the current master tree.

attacker_preconditions: A caller can provide source-selector environment input before Framework CRS provisioning.
An upstream mutable tag or branch mapping changes before the affected provisioning path runs.
root_cause_triage.impact: An altered CRS source tree can enter Framework provisioning and rule preparation under an otherwise expected HTTPS origin.
countercontrols: The current master script validates the literal HTTPS GitHub origin, full immutable commit, and external source-root handling.
The current master script keeps release metadata out of Git content selection and compares selected object identity after fetch and checkout.
root_cause_triage.root_control_boundary: Framework CRS source-provenance validation before provisioning consumption.

residual_risk: The approved commit is not independently verified through a signed release-attestation chain; the control relies on the centrally reviewed literal and HTTPS/TLS Git transport. The path also assumes trusted Framework code, CI_ROOT, Git binary/PATH, TLS trust store, and exclusive source-root ownership.
residual_risk_de: Der genehmigte Commit wird nicht zusätzlich über eine Kette signierter Release-Attestierungen verifiziert; die Kontrolle vertraut dem zentral geprüften Literal und HTTPS/TLS-Git-Transport. Der Pfad setzt außerdem vertrauenswürdigen Framework-Code, CI_ROOT, Git-Binary/PATH, TLS-Trust-Store und exklusives Source-Root-Ownership voraus.
